description: This file defines an abstract controller class for the OrangeHRM project, providing common functionality for other controllers such as managing database backup services and customizing HTTP responses.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract controller that provides shared functionalities such as retrieving a database backup service instance and customizing HTTP responses for derived controllers.

methods.name: getDatabaseBackupService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DatabaseBackupService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Overrides the parent class's method to customize the response headers to specify JSON content type.
